info.title: Connect Gate 6 trusted provisioning HTTP API
info.description: Implemented provisioning subset. This file does not claim the rest of the Gate 6 HTTP API or remote TLS hosting is implemented or qualified.

servers.description: Configured loopback HTTP listener; replace with the actual bound address.

post.description: Trusted backend only. Requires current admin authority, same tenant and permitted recipient. No browser Origin or provider call/chat identity headers. Body <=65536 bytes; bounded concurrent admission and a five-second total request budget. The body target must match the URL target. Mutations revalidate authorization transactionally, including receipt replay. Use the same operation_id after uncertain transport loss.

200.description: Completed or replayed; current resource projection

400.description: Invalid shape, address or route/body target mismatch

403.description: Missing current admin, tenant or recipient authority; browser/provider-context request denied

409.description: Changed intent, duplicate claim, immutable owner or stale revision

410.description: Expired result with retained digest tombstone

post.summary: Enroll a device verification key and bind a current credential
post.description: Trusted backend only. Requires current admin authority, same tenant and permitted recipient. No browser Origin or provider call/chat identity headers. Body <=65536 bytes; bounded concurrent admission and a five-second total request budget. The body target must match the URL target. Mutations revalidate authorization transactionally, including receipt replay. Use the same operation_id after uncertain transport loss. Only same-owner current credentials and devices may bind. Canonical issue times come from the issuer. Key validity is immutable, expires within one year, and key IDs cannot be reused. Bounds include retired history: 64 keys per Device and 128 credential bindings per key; overflow refuses without eviction. Metadata is not a current execution grant.

post.summary: Permanently revoke an immutable credential ID with a durable logical receipt
post.description: Trusted backend only. Requires current admin authority, same tenant and permitted recipient. No browser Origin or provider call/chat identity headers. Body <=65536 bytes; bounded concurrent admission and a five-second total request budget. The body target must match the URL target. Mutations revalidate authorization transactionally, including receipt replay. Use the same operation_id after uncertain transport loss. Credential revocation is terminal and needs no revision. Self-revocation may complete, but replay requires another current administrator credential for the same owner Identity. Results contain IDs, expiry and revoked state only; no bearer, verifier or scope.

operatorBearer.description: Server-side operator credential with admin operation and explicit recipient scope.

address.description: Canonical reachable address. QUIC requires an explicit port; browser transports require HTTPS without userinfo/query/fragment; SIP requires a user and host without password; telephone/SMS require E.164; Vapi uses a bounded assistant reference.

secret_ref.description: Reference to server-owned secret configuration. Required for SIP, telephone, SMS and Vapi. Never credential plaintext.

public_key.description: Canonical unpadded base64url. Runtime validates the Ed25519 point or uncompressed SEC1 P-256 point; weak/invalid points are refused.

expected_revision.description: Omit/null when creating a key; current key revision is required to bind another credential.

private_sources.description: Explicitly grant Participant-restricted record sources. Credential recipient ceilings still apply.
